# secret-store

A ClusterSecretStore pointing at a backend the lab holds.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| caBundle | null or (submodule) | `null` | A CA to verify the store's certificate against.  Needed whenever the lab hosts the store itself: it answers at a lab hostname over TLS the lab's own CA signed, and external-secrets verifies against the pod's trust store, which has never heard of it. Every lab-hosted store failed `InvalidProviderConfig` until something pointed at the CA the cluster already carries. A store elsewhere is signed by a public CA and must keep using the pod's own roots, so this is null by default.  |
| path | string | `"secret"` | KV mount path. |
| server | string | *(required)* | Base URL of the vault-compatible server. Required.  Reachable from *every* cluster that uses the store. An in-cluster address resolves only inside the cluster running the store, and a subscriber elsewhere waits forever on something it cannot dial — the lab refuses that combination rather than letting it render.  |
| tokenSecret | submodule | `{}` | Where the store's own credential lives. |
| version | one of "v1", "v2" | `"v2"` | KV engine version. Writing a v2 mount as though it were v1 succeeds and stores the wrong shape, which nothing notices until a reader gets an envelope where it expected a value.  |

| labStore | [LAB_SECRET_STORE](../signatures/LAB_SECRET_STORE.md) | A store on the operator's machine that `cata` reads authored secret values from. |
